messages:
sam: quick heads-up: i'm going to flip a router policy for /v1/embeddings in staging. enforcing a 1_000_000 byte raw payload cap + an automatic split path for mixed-dim inputs. want console + telemetry owners to review before rollout.
mae: thanks. small clarification: is the cap measured pre-gzip or post-gzip? and will clients see a 413 now for large requests? we should update console docs.
sam: cap is on raw request bytes (pre-gzip). router will 413 if a single item or full request exceeds 1_000_000 and cannot be split. otherwise we attempt auto-split for mixed dims.
dario: auto-splitting is fine, but we need strong telemetry to attribute latency/cost changes. propose event "embed.split.auto" with original_request_id, parts_count, and an estimate multiplier.
kiara: add metrics: embed.split.part_duration_ms, embed.split.parts_per_request, and embed.split.kv_prefetch_hit for cache impact. console should surface a small badge on route details: "split applied" with counts.
sam: will emit the events and metrics you mentioned. console badge on route detail planned.
dario: UI note: avoid noisy toasts. prefer a per-route daily counter plus a spike alert for 10m windows.
mae: UX: show dims for each part (e.g., 512,768) and a sample input length so customers can reason about batching. link to request inspector for the full breakdown.
sam: agree. will include dims and sample sizes in the inspector and route table.
ops-bot: deploy queued by sam at 2024-10-12T14:23:01Z. staged rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 60m if no regressions.
kiara: add a canary circuit: if embed.split.error_rate > 0.5% OR 5xx_rate increases >0.2% relative, auto-rollback. also watch median first_byte_latency for user-perceived regressions.
dario: measure both per-part latency and aggregate completion latency. Splitting can increase total RTT; we need to log first-part latency vs full-response latency.
mae: can we introduce an opt-out header? e.g., `X-Embed-Split: auto|client|never`. default is auto. advanced clients can set client to take responsibility.
sam: implemented header support: X-Embed-Split with auto|client|never. default auto. will document in API and console docs.
mae: when split can't solve it (single item >1_000_000) return 413 with body `{"error":"item_too_large","max_bytes":1000000}`. helpful for client-side retry.
kiara: for those 413 events, emit telemetry with item_sha256_prefix and dim_hint (no raw content), so support can triage without PII.
sam: emitting `embed.reject.item_too_large` with sha_prefix and dim_hint.
dario: billing/console: splitting affects token/unit counting. surface an `estimated_unit_multiplier` in the inspector so customers see cost delta (round up conservatively).
mae: also call out that split sub-requests each count against quotas (max_items, max_bytes). update quota docs.
sam: example router log i'll include in PR diff:
```
router: recv req id=req_9a8b bytes=1_234_567 dims=[512,1024,512] decision=split auto parts=2
splitter: part0 bytes=615_432 dims=[512,512] part1 bytes=619_135 dims=[1024]
telemetry: emit embed.split.auto id=req_9a8b parts=2 est_mult=1.95
```
kiara: please add unit tests for header opt-out and metric emission.
sam: will add tests. PR: https://git/repo/compare/embed/splitter-policy (incoming). staging canary group ready for whitelisting. ping me to join.
mae: console asks: allow SRE to set per-tenant preference `prefer_client_split` in routing policy (soft-block router auto-split). useful for latency-sensitive tenants.
dario: agree; make it a per-tenant routing override in the console UI and a flag in policy config.
sam: adding `prefer_client_split` config to backlog and will wire it post-PR.
mae: one more: show a helpful hint in the inspector when split happened: "Consider standardizing dims or client-side pre-splitting to reduce roundtrips."
kiara: i'll create a runbook for split regressions and add alerting notes to the console docs.
sam: rolling to staging now. staging at 10% looks good after 15m. metrics flowing to ingestion. i'll post verification checklist in #eng-sre.
mae: verified sample events and added dashboard widgets for embed.split.auto.count and embed.split.part_duration_ms.
kiara: closing loop: adding runbook and console docs.
dario: minor follow-up: include part_order mapping so we can reassemble traces easily when parts reorder.
sam: will include `part_index` and `original_request_id` in events. thanks everyone, PR in ~30m. :rocket: deploy-bot: deploy started to staging at 2024-10-12T14:28:12Z
sam: closing thread — follow up in PR comments with links.
